## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change, its purpose and any before/after behavior.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Validation

List exact format, lint, test, build and secret-scan commands and their outcomes.
Include failures and unavailable checks; do not present skipped checks as passing.

## Migrations

Describe schema/config/protocol changes, persistence impact and rollback.
Write "None" if not applicable.

## Known limitations and risks

Include upstream compatibility, recovery behavior and any unresolved checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] One phase/topic on a `codex/<number>-<topic>` branch.
- [ ] Diff reviewed; original license notices retained.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime databases or populated environment files committed.
- [ ] Existing tests preserved and relevant checks executed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect implemented behavior.
- [ ] No merge while required tests/checks fail.
